name: graphicmotion
description: Home Deluxe motion-graphics pipeline: HTML compositions rendered frame by frame to MP4.

scripts.whirlpool:sound: npm run whirlpool:audio && node scripts/dump_events.js projects/whirlpool-rechenbeispiel/composition.html build/whirlpool/events.json && python3 -I scripts/sound_design.py build/whirlpool/events.json build/whirlpool/voiceover.wav build/whirlpool/sound
scripts.whirlpool:render: npm run whirlpool:sound && node scripts/render.js projects/whirlpool-rechenbeispiel/composition.html projects/whirlpool-rechenbeispiel/output/HomeDeluxe_BlackWeek_Whirlpool-Rechenbeispiel_9x16.mp4 --audio build/whirlpool/sound/mix.wav
scripts.whirlpool:remux: npm run whirlpool:sound && node scripts/remux_audio.js projects/whirlpool-rechenbeispiel/output/HomeDeluxe_BlackWeek_Whirlpool-Rechenbeispiel_9x16.mp4 build/whirlpool/sound/mix.wav
scripts.staffelrabatt:sound: npm run staffelrabatt:audio && node scripts/dump_events.js projects/staffelrabatt-black-week/composition.html build/staffelrabatt-black-week/events.json && python3 -I scripts/sound_design.py build/staffelrabatt-black-week/events.json build/staffelrabatt-black-week/voiceover.wav build/staffelrabatt-black-week/sound
